policy: Mappings are narrow local evidence, never release qualification. Read limits for scope.

CONC-01.limits: Rejects competing instances; fair scheduling and actual separate MCP-client mutation remain untested.

CONC-02.limits: Controlled thread contention; no randomized stress test.

CONC-03.limits: Distinct DISPLAY strings; aliases for one X server are not qualified.

CONC-04.limits: Real child process killed while holding lock; does not verify input cleanup on server death.

ERR-04.limits: Subprocess timeout only; no late-effect oracle or end-to-end operation budget.

KEY-07.limits: Command dispatch mocked; schema-level coercion tested separately.

OBS-06.limits: Expired token rejected before target lookup in unit test.

SEC-03.limits: Real subprocess argv round-trip and sentinel file oracle.

SEC-04.limits: Directory checks only; concurrent path substitution and preexisting lock inode remain unqualified.

STATE-01.limits: Unit test proves no lookup after expiration.

STATE-02.limits: Unknown element handle only; window tokens require separate cross-server testing.

WIN-03.limits: Simulated changed start time, not actual PID recycling.
